headline: AI Has Completely Rewritten the Rules of the Stock Market
summary: AI on/AI off is now driving the stock market.  Rocky Fishman at Asym Research points out that of the 11 sectors that make up the  five have a zero or negative correlation with the index over the past five months, including healthcare and real estate.  If I told you the  exchange-traded fund is up 1.2% this week—it is—you wouldn’t be any closer to knowing that the S&P 500 is falling 0.2%, which it is.
